title: iPhone held by fix-nav-morph, unused for 5 min while 3 jobs wait

messages.text:
fix-nav-morph has held the iPhone lease for 5 min without a phone run (iphone.mjs run, scroll, record or gesture; since 07:22Z, lease taken by fix-nav-morph). The limit is 5 min.
Queued for it: fix-rest-script, cd-roll-ca.
Waiting on the status board: cd-roll-ca (owner fix-cd-roll-ca; waits on the phone).
fix-nav-morph: run your phone part now, or release the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner fix-nav-morph) so the next one can start, or say here why it waits. Desk (mgmt-ops-10): please make sure the phone is used.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the phone is used again or released (tools/idle.mjs, I-105, I-111).
